{{Recipe}}

This is like a coffee cake and can be served as [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] or a snack. It uses no flour and is therefore kosher for Passover.

==Ingredients==

=== Cake ===
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|oil]]
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Matzo Meal|matzo cake meal]]
* 5 [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] (Granny Smiths are best)

=== Topping ===
* ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]]
* ½ cup sugar
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]

== Procedure ==
# In a medium-sized mixing bowl, [[Cookbook:Beating|beat]] the eggs with the sugar and oil until the mixture is light.
# Add the cake meal and mix well.
# Pour half of the mixture into a lightly-greased 8–9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] square [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|baking pan]].
# Distribute half the apples over the batter.
# Pour the remaining batter over the apples, and cover with the remaining apples.
# Combine topping ingredients in a small bowl; sprinkle over the apples.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a preheated 350°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for approximately 1 ½ hours.
